entities.name: Diebold Schilling the Elder
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Diebold Schilling the Elder was the author of several of the Swiss illustrated chronicles, the Berner Schilling of 1483, the Zürcher Schilling of 1484, and the Spiezer Schilling (1480s).
